references.text: The wave offering (tenufa) is also described here, where the fat and breast are to be waved as a wave offering before the Lord.
Moses performs the actual consecration ritual described in Exodus 29:24, placing all of it into Aaron's and his sons' hands and waving it as a wave offering before the Lord.
Aaron and his sons perform the wave offering after being consecrated, continuing the practice established at their consecration.
The wave offering is also used in purification rituals, where the lamb is waved as a wave offering before the Lord.
The priest places the offering into the Nazirite's hands and waves it as a wave offering before the Lord, the same ritual action as during the priests' consecration.
Continuation of the same consecration ritual, where the breast and thigh are also to be waved as a wave offering.
Direct narrative parallel: The instruction in Exodus 29 is completed in Leviticus 8.
